question: Do representative-kept/rejected decisions remain constant over every member for a larger deterministic word sample in all 16 classes?
number: 160,000 complete groups and 5,242,880,000 exact word/member evaluations: 80,000 all-alive groups, 80,000 all-dead groups, 0 mixed groups, 0 internal errors, 0 expected-label mismatches.
notes: Deterministic finite sample: first 5,000 representative-kept and first 5,000 representative-rejected typed words per class, all 32,768 members. Stronger evidence only; universal class invariance remains OPEN and no saving is credited.
